tools.name: async_batch

tools.name: chatgpt_chatgpt
tools.description: Extract structured data from ChatGPT, answer text, cited sources, shopping cards, brand entities, and ads, for any prompt across supported regions. Required: country, prompt. Optional: disableWebSearch (default: false), include, legacy (default: false) (plus 1 more). Returns the new ChatGptmonitorResponse.

params.name: country
params.description: Country/region code for localized response, using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.

params.name: disableWebSearch
params.description: Do not force ChatGPT's web search. cloro returns the answer ChatGPT gives on its own, which uses web search only when ChatGPT decides to, so result.sources, result.citationPills and result.searchQueries are often empty. Defaults to false: web search is forced on every request.

params.name: include-ads
params.description: Include ads displayed in ChatGPT response. ChatGPT currently shows ads only in answers to a follow-up prompt, and far more often on the legacy interface: send prompt as an array with legacy: true. Paid add-on: one flat +2 credits covers any combination of rawResponse, searchQueries, ads and shopping ([pricing](https://cloro.dev/docs/guides/providers?utm_source=printing-press-library&utm_medium=byok#chatgpt-additional-features)).

params.name: include-html
params.description: Include a URL to the full HTML of the response

params.name: include-markdown
params.description: Include markdown-formatted response in the result

params.name: include-product-details
params.description: Add the rationale and reviews from each product's sheet as productDetails. Needs shopping. +2 credits on top of shopping.

params.name: include-raw-response
params.description: Include ChatGPT's raw response payload. Paid add-on: one flat +2 credits covers any combination of rawResponse, searchQueries, ads and shopping ([pricing](https://cloro.dev/docs/guides/providers?utm_source=printing-press-library&utm_medium=byok#chatgpt-additional-features)).

params.name: include-search-queries
params.description: Include the query fan-out ChatGPT used to generate the response. Paid add-on: one flat +2 credits covers any combination of rawResponse, searchQueries, ads and shopping ([pricing](https://cloro.dev/docs/guides/providers?utm_source=printing-press-library&utm_medium=byok#chatgpt-additional-features)).

params.name: include-shopping
params.description: Include shopping cards and inline products with pricing and offers. Paid add-on: one flat +2 credits covers any combination of rawResponse, searchQueries, ads and shopping ([pricing](https://cloro.dev/docs/guides/providers?utm_source=printing-press-library&utm_medium=byok#chatgpt-additional-features)).

params.name: legacy
params.description: Serve ChatGPT's legacy desktop interface instead of the default mobile-web one. The legacy interface streams the answer as an event stream, so result.model, result.searchQueries and result.mapSearchQueries are populated. ChatGPT shows ads far more often on this interface. Best-effort and temporary: OpenAI controls which interface it serves and can retire the legacy one at any time, so a request can still come back in the mobile-web shape. Handle both. Defaults to false.

params.name: prompt
params.description: The prompt to send to ChatGPT, or an array of up to 5 prompts for a multi-turn conversation. With an array, ChatGPT answers the prompts in order, in the same conversation, and result is an array with one response for each prompt. Each prompt after the first costs +1 credit ([pricing](https://cloro.dev/docs/guides/providers?utm_source=printing-press-library&utm_medium=byok#chatgpt-additional-features)).

params.name: state
params.description: State code for sub-country geo-targeting (e.g., 'CA'). Only valid with country 'US'. Paid add-on: +2 credits, on top of the base cost and any other add-on ([pricing](https://cloro.dev/docs/guides/providers?utm_source=printing-press-library&utm_medium=byok#state-level-targeting)).

tools.description: Extract structured data from Google Search including organic results, People Also Ask, related searches, and optional AI Overview. Optional: country, device (default: desktop), gl (plus 7 more). Returns the new GoogleMonitorResponse.

Required in the standard request shape unless you send gl. When you supply 'url' instead, country is derived from the URL's 'gl', pass it explicitly to override that, or when the URL has no 'gl'.

params.description: Device the search is run from. 'desktop' returns the desktop SERP; 'ios' (Safari on iPhone), 'android' (Chrome on Android) and 'mobile' (alias for 'android') all return the mobile SERP.

params.name: gl
params.description: Alternative to `country`, using Google's own parameter name for the result geography.

params.name: hl
params.description: Interface language, as Google's own `hl` parameter (e.

params.description: Include the Google AI Overview in result.aioverview. Paid add-on: +2 credits.

params.name: include-html
params.description: Include raw HTML response from Google search

params.description: Hydrate AI-Overview-type People Also Ask items with markdown content and sources. Paid add-on: one flat +2 credits covers aioverview and paaAioverview, alone or together ([pricing](https://cloro.dev/docs/guides/providers?utm_source=printing-press-library&utm_medium=byok#google-search-multi-page-pricing)). Each hydrated item adds one scraper fetch (typically 1-2 per page), so responses take longer.

params.name: location
params.description: Google canonical location name for geo-targeted results, in comma-separated format: 'City,Region,Country' (see https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/reference/data/geotargets for all ~100,000 supported locations). Use alongside 'country' for city-level precision. Mutually exclusive with 'uule', provide one or the other, not both. Cannot be combined with 'url'. When both location and uule are omitted, cloro pins results to the country's canonical location (e.g. Portugal for PT) where it has one; otherwise Google geolocates from the proxy's exit IP.

params.name: pages
params.description: Number of search results pages to scrape (1-10). Paid add-on: +2 credits per page after the first ([pricing](https://cloro.dev/docs/guides/providers?utm_source=printing-press-library&utm_medium=byok#google-search-multi-page-pricing)). Cannot be combined with 'url', in that shape, depth comes from the URL's 'num' (rounded up to whole pages of 10, capped at 10 pages).

params.name: query
params.description: The search query to execute on Google. Required unless you supply 'url' instead, the two are mutually exclusive.

params.name: url
params.description: A complete Google web search URL to run instead of building the request from 'query' and the targeting fields. Must be an absolute http(s) URL on a Google web search host (google.com, google.co.uk, www.google.de, ...), with the path '/search' and a non-empty 'q'. Mutually exclusive with 'query', 'location', 'uule' and 'pages', the URL owns those values. cloro applies a fixed set of query parameters, 'q', 'gl', 'hl', 'uule', 'num' (read as result depth), 'start', 'tbs' and 'safe', and drops anything else. URLs carrying 'tbm' are rejected, because they target a Google vertical with its own endpoint and pricing (use POST /v1/monitor/google/news for tbm=nws).

params.name: uule
params.description: Pre-encoded Google UULE string for precise geo-targeting. Use this when you have a pre-built UULE value instead of a location name. Mutually exclusive with 'location', provide one or the other, not both. Cannot be combined with 'url'; put 'uule' in the URL's query string instead.

Costs 1 credit per request, with no sync surcharge, and only when the call returns the destination. Each request resolves one link. If the link does not resolve, the call returns `502`, and you can retry it later. Required: url.

params.name: url
params.description: The Google redirect link to resolve, as an absolute URL. Must be a google.com or www.google.com link with a /goto or /url path, the form shipped as redirectLink beside every resolved link on Google Search, Google News, and AI Mode responses.
